{{Infobox auto|type=Explosive|renewable=Yes}}
A '''bedrock buster''' is a special charge of [[TNT]] that destroys {{MCW|Bedrock|bedrock}}, {{MCW|Trial Spawner|trial spawners}} and {{MCW|Vault|vaults}}. Placed on a block, it becomes a glowing primed TNT, and just before it explodes it clears a 3×7×3 column of these blocks around itself, letting players break through the floor of the Overworld or the roof and floor of [[Hell]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Each bedrock buster costs {{ItemLink|Pith}}, the pack's scarcest progression material.

== Usage ==
The bedrock buster is a spawn egg that holds a primed TNT entity.<ref name="item">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/bedrock_buster.json}}</ref> Using it on a block:
# spawns a primed, glowing TNT with an 80-tick (4-second) fuse and explosion power 4;
# 79 ticks later, at every glowing TNT with 2 ticks of fuse left, removes every bedrock block, trial spawner and vault in a 3×7×3 area centered on the TNT (1 block to each side horizontally, 3 blocks up and down) and releases a burst of end rod particles;<ref name="use">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/bedrock_buster/bedrock_buster_use.mcfunction}}</ref><ref name="effects">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/bedrock_buster/bedrock_buster_effects.mcfunction}}</ref><ref name="tag">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/bedrock_bustable.json}}</ref>
# the TNT then explodes normally one tick later, damaging the surrounding blocks and entities.

The removal is triggered by an advancement when the buster is used on a block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/bedrock_buster.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/bedrock_buster/bedrock_buster.mcfunction}}</ref> Each use schedules its own removal, so several busters used in quick succession each clear their own column.

The 1.12.9 release notes give the reason trial spawners and vaults were added: "In case you want to live in an Abbey's basement".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.9|quote=Bedrock busters can now bust Trial Spawners and vault (In case you want to live in an Abbey's basement)}}</ref>

=== Spawners ===
{{Main|Spawner#Spawn eggs}}
Because it is a spawn egg, using a bedrock buster on a spawner counts as putting a spawn egg on it: every spawner and trial spawner within 16 blocks is destroyed and the player takes 1 damage (20 until 1.12.8-beta).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/no_eggs_on_spawners.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/no_egg_on_spawner.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The item is a chicken spawn egg with a custom model.
* In the design video, bedrock busters are listed among the items that need a divine fragment (now [[pith]]), as part of the reasoning against building mob farms: "If you want to make an unbreaking book, Bedrock Busters, Crystal Hearts, or netherite, you need that fragment."<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If you want to make an unbreaking book, Bedrock Busters, Crystal Hearts, or netherite, you need that fragment.}}</ref>
